threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Underground' instead of just the 'Tube'—trust me, you’ll learn soon enough when the strikes hit.
Heard a guy on the 59 passionately trying to explain the plot of Inception to a baffled driver, who just nodded and kept driving.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a kid selling lemonade on the corner, while the baker next door handed out free bread. That's when I felt it.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only here can you sip on a craft beer while watching a spontaneous dance-off on the sidewalk. Kreuzberg’s street culture hits different.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by the way they roll their eyes at tourists trying to decipher the BART map. We know it’s easier to just check Twitter for the latest delays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Spotted a guy balancing on a Muni seat at 16th Street, holding a saxophone. Most passengers didn't blink. Just another Tuesday commute in the Mission.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the Gràcia Festa Major is just a party, but it’s really a year-round labor of love by locals who pluck flowers for months.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they stand at the crosswalk, waiting for the light, while locals dart through red just to get to the café.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still try to grab a seat on the bus. Locals know you have to be quick and just stand your ground.
Last night on the 322, a guy tried to sell his mixtape to everyone. By the time we hit Stockwell, he had a mini fan club.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: One morning, I saw a guy in a full suit casually feeding pigeons while debating politics with a friend over coffee. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a currywurst and sit on a swingset made from repurposed bike parts while listening to a live punk band in a park.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Locals know to never trust the BART schedule. If they suggest a backup plan, they're from here. Tourists just get frustrated.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy juggle on the bus while a grandma scolded him for interrupting her nap. Classic Muni—chaos wrapped in community.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are just for photo ops, but locals know they're the heartbeat of community life, especially during the evening jam sessions.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewildered looks at the metro signs, still holding tightly to their paper map like it's a treasure map.
